name: live_two_cells_two_interiors
description: Two peers in two different interiors. Both start in Doc Mitchell's house. The guest walks to the Prospector Saloon and hits Sunny Smiles there. Each peer must own and run the people of its own cell, the host must count the guest's people as the guest's, and neither peer may mirror the other cell's people. After the split the host sets CG03TestValue and the guest asks the host to set DemoVatsCameraGlobal: both values must reach both peers, and the shared hash must agree. A `coop hit NAME 1` line hits that person once for 1 point. The line also names the person, so the simulator loads it (the viewer loads the whole cell). Headless only: the viewer bot has no `coop cell` verb.
